notes.title: Restaurant Builder Demo Update
notes.content:
Hello Restauranters,

[b][h3]We have a big surprise for you! A demo update that will add not one, but two new levels! [/h3][/b]

[u]One is an Asian-style restaurant[/u] that you can arrange in your way and run to satisfy customers, and the other is a classic American garden with BBQ - no renovation or cleaning required, just cooking! You can buy these locations in the game's "Buy/Sell Property" section on the tablet [TAB].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/f15aebdc73f6080fd07dd1a03d74d826cd5e0e86.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/ff6156f97a48e4e579a6b98d2c64aa113a83ffb4.png[/img]

[b]Check out the new cool grills - carbeque rules![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/5cdd86b06c35ad25b6a848e100ee8de2917c6753.png[/img]

We've also[b] added new ingredients[/b]: two types of buns, onion, veggie cutlet, and yummy bacon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/23ec9db528f6f7e4cc4ac603579fbfed812bd463.png[/img]

What's more, you will be able to make a [b]new recipe - tortilla[/b]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/4fa16a7cf94409777da2716483210ae8bd84c480.png[/img]

There are also fixes and improvements to some UIs and translations, as well as many more bug fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/d5f60fc8c62716b18447d38c9896c619b0dd8199.png[/img]

[h3][b]List of changes[/b][/h3]

[list]
[*] New levels available: Oriental-style restaurant for renovating and managing, and an American garden with BBQ, exclusively for cooking
[*] New items added to the shop
[*] A new recipe is now available
[*] New ingredients are now available
[*] UI improvements
[*] Translation enhancements
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]


Don't wait, check out this update!

Restaurant Builder Team

notes.title: Building in progress!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings restauranters,[/h2]

It was quiet for some time, but our Restaurant Builder is alive and well. We are working hard on the game without slowing down! We'll have some important news to share with you soon, but first, let's catch up on some current events.

[h3][b]Redesign[/b][/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/749bb22915c2e5e4116f5b4badf14942b9326216.jpg[/img]

As you have seen Restaurant Builder was all about building, but we thought it was not enough. Restaurants always feature hungry clients and food. We have decided to add that to our game.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YHBjIEB.gif[/img]


[h3][b]Work in progress[/b][/h3]

We have prepared something to share with you.

[b]1. New pre-alpha gameplay[/b]

[previewyoutube=3lDwXo7esFk;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]2. A few screenshots from the pre-alpha version of the game[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/80a644621ac9130bd6fa6f391cf3c2155aa00496.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/4d5fe50a8a8f6f8dff7c61b51f182a19faa2a4bf.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/a08feeeb28647005016e840ba02066d362fc1fda.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/39cef4cda78342a26f7d727bb7b22f5ad6c1bb2b.jpg[/img]

[b]3. We have changed Restaurant Builder Steam graphics[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43583306/b13a5c1645f9d82c7d4d8aaaec17940bfe88d712.jpg[/img]

That's it for today, but we'll be back soon with another devlog where we show more of the key features of Restaurant Builder. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2235490/Restaurant_Builder/

If you want to share your thoughts about the devlog or the game itself, just join our [b][url=https://discord.com/invite/YBVMXVCEAN]Discord[/url][/b] and add Restaurant Builder to your wishlist on Steam!


We thank that you are with us,
FreeMind Games

PS. We have just announced one of a kind next-gen gardening simulation game "Gardener". Check it out and if you like it, add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2052790/Gardener/

Here is the reveal trailer: [previewyoutube=eZweJcQumIo;full][/previewyoutube]
